Project Title: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer (Project SSG_LAREN_720f)

Summary: Developed an interactive 3D planetary rover simulation and mission trainer designed to introduce younger learners to space exploration challenges. The app features simulated rover telemetry (such as core temperature, standby power, and dust accumulation), navigation controls, and real-time mission parameters to engage students in planetary science and engineering concepts.

  • This project is an interactive 3D planetary rover simulation and mission trainer designed for the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge.</span><span> Players pilot a planetary rover across rugged extraterrestrial terrain to navigate waypoints,</span><span> collect geological samples,</span><span> and complete mission objectives.</span><span> To succeed,</span><span> players must actively monitor real-time rover telemetry—including battery power reserves,</span><span> core internal temperatures,</span><span> and solar-panel dust accumulation—while adapting to sudden environmental hazards like dust storms.</span></p><p dir="ltr" data-path-to-node="3"><b data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits & Intended Impact</b><span>
  • Space exploration engineering is often presented to students through complex textbooks or static diagrams.</span><span> By turning real planetary mission constraints into hands-on gameplay,</span><span> this trainer makes STEM concepts tangible,</span><span> intuitive,</span><span> and engaging for young learners.</span><span> Players develop critical thinking and resource-management skills as they experience firsthand how engineers balance power consumption,</span><span> thermal regulation,</span><span> and navigation risks to keep a rover alive on another
